themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously perform research tasks, make decisions, and interact with systems.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Covers a broad category of AI-powered tools designed to assist in various aspects of research, including data analysis, information gathering, and workflow automation.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Examines AI tools that help developers write, review, and debug code, including security aspects and potential vulnerabilities.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Articles discussing AI's capability to condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries for easier understanding.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Explores the use of AI to automate various stages of software testing, from test case generation to execution and analysis.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: Covers AI applications that directly assist designers and researchers in their creative and analytical processes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Articles that analyze how AI is affecting jobs, recruitment, and the skills required in the modern workforce.

themes.name: Conversational AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on chatbots and other conversational AI interfaces used to interact with users or gather information in research contexts.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses platforms and ecosystems that provide a suite of AI tools and services for research and development.

themes.name: AI tool evaluation
themes.description: Articles that compare, review, and assess the performance and usability of various AI tools.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
